passages.text: Quo tu, quo, liber otiose, tendis

passages.text: Turbam non habet otiosiorem

passages.text: Non urbana mea tantum Piplei+de gaudent

passages.text: Otia, nec vacuis auribus ista damus,

passages.text: Dicitur et nostros cantare Britannia versus.

passages.label: Mart. 11.3.7
passages.text: At quam victuras poteramus pangere chartas

passages.label: Mart. 11.3.8
passages.text: Quantaque Pieria proelia flare tuba,

passages.label: Mart. 11.4.1
passages.text: Sacra laresque Phrygum, quos Troiae maluit heres

passages.label: Mart. 11.4.2
passages.text: Quam rapere arsuras Laomedontis opes,

passages.label: Mart. 11.4.3
passages.text: Scriptus et aeterno nunc primum Iuppiter auro

passages.label: Mart. 11.4.4
passages.text: Et soror et summi filia tota patris,

passages.text: Et qui purpureis iam tertia nomina fastis,

passages.text: Iane, refers Nervae; vos precor ore pio:

passages.text: Hunc omnes servate ducem, servate senatum;

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.1
passages.text: Tanta tibi est recti reverentia, Caesar, et aequi,

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.2
passages.text: Quanta Numae fuerat: sed Numa pauper erat.

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.3
passages.text: Ardua res haec est, opibus non tradere mores

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.4
passages.text: Et, cum tot Croesos viceris, esse Numam.

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.5
passages.text: Si redeant veteres, ingentia nomina, patres,

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.6
passages.text: Elysium liceat si vacuare nemus:

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.7
passages.text: Te colet invictus pro libertate Camillus,

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.8
passages.text: Aurum Fabricius, te tribuente, volet;

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.9
passages.text: Te duce gaudebit Brutus, tibi Sulla cruentus

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.10
passages.text: Imperium tradet, cum positurus erit;

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.11
passages.text: Et te privato cum Caesare Magnus amabit,

passages.text: Donabit totas et tibi Crassus opes.

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.13
passages.text: Ipse quoque infernis revocatus Ditis ab umbris

passages.label: Mart. 11.5.14

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.1
passages.text: Unctis falciferi senis diebus,

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.2
passages.text: Regnator quibus imperat fritillus,

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.3
passages.text: Versu ludere non laborioso

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.4
passages.text: Permittis, puto, pilleata Roma.

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.5
passages.text: Risisti; licet ergo, non vetamur.

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.6
passages.text: Pallentes procul hinc abite curae;

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.7
passages.text: Quidquid venerit obvium, loquamur

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.8
passages.text: Morosa sine cogitatione.

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.9
passages.text: Misce dimidios, puer, trientes,

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.10
passages.text: Quales Pythagoras dabat Neroni,

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.11
passages.text: Misce, Dindyme, sed frequentiores:

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.12
passages.text: Possum nil ego sobrius; bibenti

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.13
passages.text: Succurrent mihi quindecim poetae.

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.14
passages.text: Da nunc basia, sed Catulliana:

passages.text: Quae si tot fuerint, quot ille dixit,

passages.label: Mart. 11.6.16
passages.text: Donabo tibi Passerem Catulli.

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.1
passages.text: Iam certe stupido non dices, Paula, marito,

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.2
passages.text: Ad moechum quotiens longius ire voles,

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.3
passages.text: 'Caesar in Albanum iussit me mane venire,

passages.text: Caesar Circeios.' Iam stropha talis abi=t.

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.5
passages.text: Penelopae licet esse tibi sub principe Nerva:

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.6
passages.text: Sed prohibet scabies ingeniumque vetus.

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.7
passages.text: Infelix, quid ages? aegram simulabis amicam?

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.8
passages.text: Haerebit dominae vir comes ipse suae,

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.9
passages.text: Ibit et ad fratrem tecum matremque patremque.

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.10
passages.text: Quas igitur fraudes ingeniosa paras?

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.11
passages.text: Diceret hystericam se forsitan altera moecha

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.12
passages.text: In Sinuessano velle sedere lacu.

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.13
passages.text: Quanto tu melius, quotiens placet ire fututum,

passages.label: Mart. 11.7.14
passages.text: Quae verum mavis dicere, Paula, viro!

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.1
passages.text: Lassa quod hesterni spirant opobalsama dracti,

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.2
passages.text: Ultima quod curvo quae cadit aura croco;

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.3
passages.text: Poma quod hiberna maturescentia capsa,

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.4
passages.text: Arbore quod verna luxuriosus ager;

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.5
passages.text: De Palatinis dominae quod Serica prelis,

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.6
passages.text: Sucina virginea quod regelata manu;

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.7
passages.text: Amphora quod nigri, sed longe, fracta Falerni,

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.8
passages.text: Quod qui Sicanias detinet hortus apes;

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.9
passages.text: Quod Cosmi redolent alabastra focique deorum,

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.10
passages.text: Quod modo divitibus lapsa corona comis:

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.11
passages.text: Singula quid dicam? non sunt satis; omnia misce:

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.12
passages.text: Hoc fragrant pueri basia mane mei.

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.13
passages.text: Scire cupis nomen? si propter basia, dicam.

passages.label: Mart. 11.8.14
passages.text: Iurasti: nimium scire, Sabine, cupis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.9.1
passages.text: Clarus fronde Iovis, Romani fama coturni,

passages.label: Mart. 11.9.2
passages.text: Spirat Apellea redditus arte Memor.

passages.label: Mart. 11.10.1
passages.text: Contulit ad saturas ingentia pectora Turnus.

passages.label: Mart. 11.10.2
passages.text: Cur non ad Memoris carmina? Frater erat.

passages.label: Mart. 11.11.1
passages.text: Tolle, puer, calices tepidique toreumata Nili

passages.label: Mart. 11.11.2
passages.text: Et mihi secura pocula trade manu

passages.label: Mart. 11.11.3
passages.text: Trita patrum labris et tonso pura ministro;

passages.label: Mart. 11.11.4
passages.text: Anticus mensis restituatur honor.

passages.label: Mart. 11.11.5
passages.text: Te potare decet gemma, qui Mentora frangis

passages.label: Mart. 11.11.6
passages.text: In scaphium moechae, Sardanapalle, tuae.

passages.label: Mart. 11.12.1
passages.text: Ius tibi natorum vel septem, Zoile, detur,

passages.label: Mart. 11.12.2
passages.text: Dum matrem nemo det tibi, nemo patrem.

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.1
passages.text: Quisquis Flaminiam teris, viator,

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.2
passages.text: Noli nobile praeterire marmor.

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.3
passages.text: Urbis deliciae salesque Nili,

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.4
passages.text: Ars et gratia, lusus et voluptas,

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.5
passages.text: Romani decus et dolor theatri

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.6
passages.text: Atque omnes Veneres Cupidinesque

passages.label: Mart. 11.13.7
passages.text: Hoc sunt condita, quo Paris, sepulchro.

passages.label: Mart. 11.14.1
passages.text: Heredes, nolite brevem sepelire colonum:

passages.label: Mart. 11.14.2
passages.text: Nam terra est illi quantulacumque gravis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.1
passages.text: Sunt chartae mihi, quas Catonis uxor

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.2
passages.text: Et quas horribiles legant Sabinae:

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.3
passages.text: Hic totus volo rideat libellus

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.4
passages.text: Et sit nequior omnibus libellis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.5
passages.text: Qui vino madeat nec erubescat

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.6
passages.text: Pingui sordidus esse Cosmiano,

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.7
passages.text: Ludat cum pueris, amet puellas,

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.8
passages.text: Nec per circuitus loquatur illam,

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.9
passages.text: Ex qua nascimur, omnium parentem,

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.10
passages.text: Quam sanctus Numa mentulam vocabat.

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.11
passages.text: Versus hos tamen esse tu memento

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.12
passages.text: Saturnalicios, Apollinaris:

passages.label: Mart. 11.15.13
passages.text: Mores non habet hic meos libellus.

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.1
passages.text: Qui gravis es nimium, potes hinc iam, lector, abire

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.2
passages.text: Quo libet: urbanae scripsimus ista togae;

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.3
passages.text: Iam mea Lampsacio lascivit pagina versu

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.4
passages.text: Et Tartesiaca concrepat aera manu.

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.5
passages.text: O quotiens rigida pulsabis pallia vena,

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.6
passages.text: Sis gravior Curio Fabricioque licet!

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.7
passages.text: Tu quoque nequitias nostri lususque libelli

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.8
passages.text: Uda, puella, leges, sis Patavina licet.

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.9
passages.text: Erubuit posuitque meum Lucretia librum,

passages.label: Mart. 11.16.10
passages.text: Sed coram Bruto; Brute, recede: leget.

passages.label: Mart. 11.17.1
passages.text: Non omnis nostri nocturna est pagina libri:

passages.label: Mart. 11.17.2
passages.text: Invenies et quod mane, Sabine, legas.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.1
passages.text: Donasti, Lupe, rus sub urbe nobis;

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.2
passages.text: Sed rus est mihi maius in fenestra.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.3
passages.text: Rus hoc dicere, rus potes vocare?

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.4
passages.text: In quo ruta facit nemus Dianae,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.5
passages.text: Argutae tegit ala quod cicadae,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.6
passages.text: Quod formica die comedit uno,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.7
passages.text: Clusae cui folium rosae corona est;

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.8
passages.text: In quo non magis invenitur herba,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.9
passages.text: Quam Cosmi folium piperve crudum;

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.10
passages.text: In quo nec cucumis iacere rectus

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.11
passages.text: Nec serpens habitare tota possit.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.12
passages.text: Urucam male pascit hortus unam,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.13
passages.text: Consumpto moritur culex salicto,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.14
passages.text: Et talpa est mihi fossor atque arator.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.15
passages.text: Non boletus hiare, non mariscae

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.16
passages.text: Ridere aut violae patere possunt.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.17
passages.text: Finis mus populatur et colono

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.18
passages.text: Tamquam sus Calydonius timetur,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.19
passages.text: Et sublata volantis ungue Procnes

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.20
passages.text: In nido seges est hirundinino;

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.21
passages.text: Et cum stet sine falce mentulaque,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.22
passages.text: Non est dimidio locus Priapo.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.23
passages.text: Vix implet cocleam peracta messis,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.24
passages.text: Et mustum nuce condimus picata.

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.25
passages.text: Errasti, Lupe, littera sed una:

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.26
passages.text: Nam quo tempore praedium dedisti,

passages.label: Mart. 11.18.27
passages.text: Mallem tu mihi prandium dedisses.

passages.label: Mart. 11.19.1
passages.text: Quaeris, cur nolim te ducere, Galla? Diserta es.

passages.label: Mart. 11.19.2
passages.text: Saepe soloecismum mentula nostra facit.

passages.label: Mart. 11.20.1
passages.text: Caesaris Augusti lascivos, livide, versus

passages.text: Sex lege, qui tristis verba latina legis:

passages.text: 'Quod futuit Glaphyran Antonius, hanc mihi poenam

passages.label: Mart. 11.20.4
passages.text: Fulvia constituit, se quoque uti futuam.

passages.label: Mart. 11.20.5
passages.text: Fulviam ego ut futuam? quid si me Manius oret

passages.label: Mart. 11.20.6
passages.text: Pedicem, faciam? non puto, si sapiam.

passages.text: Absolvis lepidos nimirum, Auguste, libellos,

passages.text: Qui scis Romana simplicitate loqui.

passages.text: Quam veteres bracae Brittonis pauperis, et quam

passages.text: Mollia quod nivei duro teris ore Galaesi

passages.text: Basia, quod nudo cum Ganymede iaces,

passages.text: (Quis negat?) hoc nimium est. Sed sit satis; inguina saltem

passages.text: Inde tragus celeresque pili mirandaque matri

passages.text: Divisit natura marem: pars una puellis,

passages.label: Mart. 11.23.1
passages.text: Nubere Sila mihi nulla non lege parata est;

passages.label: Mart. 11.23.2
passages.text: Sed Silam nulla ducere lege volo.

passages.label: Mart. 11.23.3
passages.text: Cum tamen instaret, 'deciens mihi dotis in auro

passages.label: Mart. 11.23.4
passages.text: Sponsa dabis' dixi; 'quid minus esse potest?

passages.text: Te spectante dabit nobis lasciva minister

passages.text: Dum te prosequor et domum reduco,

passages.text: Aurem dum tibi praesto garrienti,

passages.text: Et quidquid loqueris facisque laudo,

passages.text: Quot versus poterant, Labulle, nasci!

passages.text: Sit maior numerus togatulorum,

passages.text: Triginta prope iam diebus una est

passages.text: Blanditias nescis: 'dabo' dic 'tibi milia centum

passages.text: Nec toga nec focus est nec tritus cimice lectus

passages.text: Vicit nimirum non Nero, sed prasinus

passages.text: Esse suas: adeo nigra vetusque casa est.

passages.text: Vicinos illi nitidus Maro possidet hortos.

passages.text: Ignotos mihi cum voces trecentos,

passages.text: Quare non veniam vocatus ad te,

passages.text: Miraris quererisque litigasque.

passages.label: Mart. 11.35.4
passages.text: Solus ceno, Fabulle, non libenter.

passages.text: Gaius hanc lucem gemma mihi Iulius alba

passages.label: Mart. 11.36.2
passages.text: Signat, io, votis redditus, ecce, meis:

passages.text: Desperasse iuvat veluti iam rupta sororum

passages.text: Fila; minus gaudent qui timuere nihil.

passages.text: Hypne, quid expectas, piger? inmortale Falernum

passages.text: Funde, senem poscunt talia vota cadum:

passages.text: Zoile, quid tota gemmam praecingere libra

passages.label: Mart. 11.37.2
passages.text: Te iuvat et miserum perdere sardonycha?

passages.label: Mart. 11.37.3
passages.text: Anulus iste tuis fuerat modo cruribus aptus:

passages.text: Non eadem digitis pondera conveniunt.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.1
passages.text: Cunarum fueras motor, Charideme, mearum

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.2
passages.text: Et pueri custos adsiduusque comes.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.3
passages.text: Iam mihi nigrescunt tonsa sudaria barba

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.4
passages.text: Et queritur labris puncta puella meis;

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.5
passages.text: Sed tibi non crevi: te noster vilicus horret,

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.6
passages.text: Te dispensator, te domus ipsa pavet.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.7
passages.text: Ludere nec nobis, nec tu permittis amare;

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.8
passages.text: Nil mihi vis et vis cuncta licere tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.9
passages.text: Corripis, observas, quereris, suspiria ducis,

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.10
passages.text: Et vix a ferulis temperat ira tua.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.11
passages.text: Si Tyrios sumpsi cultus unxive capillos,

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.12
passages.text: Exclamas 'Numquam fecerat ista pater';

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.13
passages.text: Et numeras nostros adstricta fronte trientes,

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.14
passages.text: Tamquam de cella sit cadus ille tua.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.15
passages.text: Desine; non possum libertum ferre Catonem.

passages.label: Mart. 11.39.16
passages.text: Esse virum iam me dicet amica tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 11.40.1
passages.text: Formosam Glyceran amat Lupercus

passages.label: Mart. 11.40.2

passages.text: Quam toto sibi mense non fututam

passages.text: Indulget pecori nimium dum pastor Amyntas

passages.text: Cedentes oneri ramos silvamque fluentem

passages.text: Triste nemus dirae vetuit superesse rapinae

passages.text: Vivida cum poscas epigrammata, mortua ponis

passages.text: Vendere, Tucca, potes centenis milibus emptos?

passages.text: Nec data sunt nigris tota labella rogis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.91.9
passages.text: Si tam praecipiti fuerant ventura volatu,

passages.label: Mart. 11.91.10
passages.text: Debuerant alia fata venire via.

passages.label: Mart. 11.91.11
passages.text: Sed mors vocis iter properavit cludere blandae,

passages.label: Mart. 11.91.12
passages.text: Ne posset duras flectere lingua deas.

passages.label: Mart. 11.92.1
passages.text: Mentitur qui te vitiosum, Zoile, dicit.

passages.label: Mart. 11.92.2
passages.text: Non vitiosus homo es, Zoile, sed vitium.

passages.label: Mart. 11.93.1
passages.text: Pierios vatis Theodori flamma penates

passages.label: Mart. 11.93.2
passages.text: Abstulit. Hoc Musis et tibi, Phoebe, placet?

passages.label: Mart. 11.93.3
passages.text: O scelus, o magnum facinus crimenque deorum,

passages.label: Mart. 11.93.4
passages.text: Non arsit pariter quod domus et dominus!

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.1
passages.text: Quod nimium lives nostris et ubique libellis

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.2
passages.text: Detrahis, ignosco: verpe poeta, sapis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.3
passages.text: Hoc quoque non curo, quod cum mea carmina carpas,

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.4
passages.text: Conpilas: et sic, verpe poeta, sapis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.5
passages.text: Illud me cruciat, Solymis quod natus in ipsis

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.6
passages.text: Pedicas puerum, verpe poeta, meum.

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.7
passages.text: Ecce negas iurasque mihi per templa Tonantis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.94.8
passages.text: Non credo: iura, verpe, per Anchialum.

passages.label: Mart. 11.95.1
passages.text: Incideris quotiens in basia fellatorum,

passages.label: Mart. 11.95.2
passages.text: In solium puta te mergere, Flacce, caput.

passages.label: Mart. 11.96.1
passages.text: Marcia, non Rhenus, salit hic, Germane: quid obstas

passages.label: Mart. 11.96.2
passages.text: Et puerum prohibes divitis imbre lacus?

passages.label: Mart. 11.96.3
passages.text: Barbare, non debet, submoto cive, ministro

passages.label: Mart. 11.96.4
passages.text: Captivam victrix unda levare sitim.

passages.label: Mart. 11.97.1
passages.text: Una nocte quater possum: sed quattuor annis

passages.label: Mart. 11.97.2
passages.text: Si possum, peream, te Telesilla semel.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.1
passages.text: Effugere non est, Flacce, basiatores.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.2
passages.text: Instant, morantur, persecuntur, occurrunt,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.3
passages.text: Et hinc et illinc, usquequaque, quacumque.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.4
passages.text: Non ulcus acre pusulaeve lucentes,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.5
passages.text: Nec triste mentum sordidique lichenes,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.6
passages.text: Nec labra pingui delibuta cerato,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.7
passages.text: Nec congelati gutta proderit nasi.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.8
passages.text: Et aestuantem basiant et algentem,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.9
passages.text: Et nuptiale basium reservantem.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.10
passages.text: Non te cucullis adseret caput tectum,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.11
passages.text: Lectica nec te tuta pelle veloque,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.12
passages.text: Nec vindicabit sella saepius clusa:

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.13
passages.text: Rimas per omnis basiator intrabit.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.14
passages.text: Non consulatus ipse, non tribunatus

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.15
passages.text: Senive fasces, nec superba clamosi

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.16
passages.text: Lictoris abiget virga basiatorem:

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.17
passages.text: Sedeas in alto tu licet tribunali

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.18
passages.text: Et e curuli iura gentibus reddas,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.19
passages.text: Ascendet illa basiator atque illa.

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.20
passages.text: Febricitantem basiabit et flentem,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.21
passages.text: Dabit oscitanti basium natantique,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.22
passages.text: Dabit et cacanti. Remedium mali solum est,

passages.label: Mart. 11.98.23
passages.text: Facias amicum basiare quem nolis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.1
passages.text: De cathedra quotiens surgis—iam saepe notavi—

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.2
passages.text: Pedicant miserae, Lesbia, te tunicae.

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.3
passages.text: Quas cum conata es dextra, conata sinistra

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.4
passages.text: Vellere, cum lacrimis eximis et gemitu:

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.5
passages.text: Sic constringuntur gemina Symplegade culi

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.6
passages.text: Et nimias intrant cyaneasque natis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.7
passages.text: Emendare cupis vitium deforme? docebo:

passages.label: Mart. 11.99.8
passages.text: Lesbia, nec surgas censeo, nec sedeas.

passages.label: Mart. 11.100.1
passages.text: Habere amicam nolo, Flacce, subtilem,

passages.label: Mart. 11.100.2
passages.text: Cuius lacertos anuli mei cingant,

passages.label: Mart. 11.100.3
passages.text: Quae clune nudo radat et genu pungat,

passages.label: Mart. 11.100.4
passages.text: Cui serra lumbis, cuspis eminet culo.

passages.label: Mart. 11.100.5
passages.text: Sed idem amicam nolo mille librarum.

passages.label: Mart. 11.100.6
passages.text: Carnarius sum, pinguiarius non sum.

passages.label: Mart. 11.101.1
passages.text: Thaida tam tenuem potuisti, Flacce, videre?

passages.label: Mart. 11.101.2
passages.text: Tu, puto, quod non est, Flacce, videre potes.

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.1
passages.text: Non est mentitus, qui te mihi dixit habere

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.2
passages.text: Formosam carnem, Lydia, non faciem.

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.3
passages.text: Est ita, si taceas et si tam muta recumbas,

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.4
passages.text: Quam silet in cera vultus et in tabula.

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.5
passages.text: Sed quotiens loqueris, carnem quoque, Lydia, perdis,

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.6
passages.text: Et sua plus nulli, quam tibi, lingua nocet.

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.7
passages.text: Audiat aedilis ne te videatque caveto:

passages.label: Mart. 11.102.8
passages.text: Portentum est, quotiens coepit imago loqui.

passages.label: Mart. 11.103.1
passages.text: Tanta tibi est animi probitas orisque, Safroni,

passages.label: Mart. 11.103.2
passages.text: Ut mirer fieri te potuisse patrem.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.1
passages.text: Uxor, vade foras, aut moribus utere nostris:

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.2
passages.text: Non sum ego nec Curius nec Numa nec Tatius.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.3
passages.text: Me iucunda iuvant tractae per pocula noctes:

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.4
passages.text: Tu properas pota surgere tristis aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.5
passages.text: Tu tenebris gaudes: me ludere teste lucerna

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.6
passages.text: Et iuvat admissa rumpere luce latus.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.7
passages.text: Fascia te tunicaeque obscuraque pallia celant:

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.8
passages.text: At mihi nulla satis nuda puella iacet.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.9
passages.text: Basia me capiunt blandas imitata columbas:

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.10
passages.text: Tu mihi das, aviae qualia mane soles.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.11
passages.text: Nec motu dignaris opus nec voce iuvare

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.12
passages.text: Nec digitis, tamquam tura merumque pares:

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.13
passages.text: Masturbabantur Phrygii post ostia servi,

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.14
passages.text: Hectoreo quotiens sederat uxor equo,

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.15
passages.text: Et quamvis Ithaco stertente pudica solebat

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.16
passages.text: Illic Penelope semper habere manum.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.17
passages.text: Pedicare negas: dabat hoc Cornelia Graccho,

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.18
passages.text: Iulia Pompeio, Porcia, Brute, tibi;

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.19
passages.text: Dulcia Dardanio nondum miscente ministro

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.20
passages.text: Pocula Iuno fuit pro Ganymede Iovi.

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.21
passages.text: Si te delectat gravitas, Lucretia toto

passages.label: Mart. 11.104.22
passages.text: Sis licet usque die: Lai+da nocte volo.

passages.label: Mart. 11.105.1
passages.text: Mittebas libram, quadrantem, Garrice, mittis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.105.2
passages.text: Saltem semissem, Garrice, solve mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 11.106.1
passages.text: Vibi Maxime, si vacas havere,

passages.label: Mart. 11.106.2
passages.text: Hoc tantum lege: namque et occupatus

passages.label: Mart. 11.106.3
passages.text: Et non es nimium laboriosus.

passages.label: Mart. 11.106.4
passages.text: Transis hos quoque quattuor? sapisti.

passages.label: Mart. 11.107.1
passages.text: Explicitum nobis usque ad sua cornua librum

passages.label: Mart. 11.107.2
passages.text: Et quasi perlectum, Septiciane, refers.

passages.label: Mart. 11.107.3
passages.text: Omnia legisti. Credo, scio, gaudeo, verum est.

passages.label: Mart. 11.107.4
passages.text: Perlegi libros sic ego quinque tuos.

passages.label: Mart. 11.108.1
passages.text: Quamvis tam longo possis satur esse libello,

passages.label: Mart. 11.108.2
passages.text: Lector, adhuc a me disticha pauca petis.

passages.label: Mart. 11.108.3
passages.text: Sed Lupus usuram puerique diaria poscunt.

passages.label: Mart. 11.108.4
passages.text: Lector, solve. Taces dissimulasque? Vale.
